Name: Bountiful Beauties Vol. 1 - Mud's Super Skimpy Anime Portraits
Author: TheMud
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00][size=4]!!WARNING!! If the image previews didn't already make it abundantly clear, this mod page is home to scandalously tiny outfits and female bosoms of somewhat exaggerated size. If that's not something you wish to see more of, please turn back now.[/size][/color][/center]

More specifically, this is a ridiculously skimpy NPC portrait and sprite overhaul mod for the six female love interests! With Dialogue Display Framework, I've redrawn and repositioned the bachelorettes' dialogue UI to present them in a way that gives more emphasis to the character art, with all-new poses and expressions for every portrait!

NOTE: Be sure to read the [color=#ff7700]Compatibility[/color] section! Because this mod uses frameworks that change the way the game displays character art, there are a number of potential display issues you'll probably need to know about, to decide if you can live with them in exchange for the jiggly bitties on display.

[size=5][b][u][color=#ffff00][center]Requirements[/center][/color][/u][/b]
[/size]This mod is made with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678?tab=description]Dialogue Display Framework Continued[/url] for the portrait component and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url] for the sprites so you'll need to download those in addition to Content Patcher! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is also recommended to access the optional appearance toggles included for summer swimsuits and Maru's glasses.

[center][color=#00ffff][size=5][b][u]The Content[/u][/b][/size][/color][/center]
Haley, Emily, Abigail, Penny, Maru, and Leah have received all-new art painstakingly drawn by me for your viewing pleasure! Outfits for summer and winter are included, although users may find them a little... indulgent?

[center][b][size=5][u]﻿[color=#ff7700]Compatibility and Known Issues
[/color][/u][/size][/b]﻿[/center][list]
[*] ﻿This mod is unsurprisingly incompatible with any other mod that changes the bachelorettes' sprites and portraits. [b]Completely incompatible with mods that add new outfits[/b] like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ unless you can edit those mods to not touch the bachelorettes or additional portrait art is provided to replace those mods'. [b]Can be used alongside vanilla replacer portraits[/b] for other characters, but you should [b]remove the bachelorette portraits from those mods[/b] or they will get loaded into this mod in a weird way. Characters not touched by this mod will just show the vanilla dialogue UI.
[*] ﻿Expect similar soft incompatibilities with anything that displays character portraits outside of dialogue, a fix is planned for vanilla features like shop portraits when more shop NPCs are added to the mod but fixes for mod incompatibilities are less likely.
[*] ﻿This mod was configured for 100% UI Scale at 1920x1080 resolution, if the dialogue does not fit your game screen try changing the UI Scale option or your game resolution in the game settings.
[/list]
